description: Run the research/audit handoff loop between an agentic coding harness and a slow, non-agentic frontier reasoning model (GPT Pro on the ChatGPT web UI, or equivalent) with the codebase pre-loaded as split zip bundles. Author a high-signal prompt, then later take the returned report, verify every finding against the LIVE codebase, and implement what holds up. Use whenever the operator wants to send something to a deep external model, prep a prompt or report, scope an issue for deep research, bug-hunting, or optimization analysis, OR when a report comes back and needs checking against the code before anything is implemented. This is the WORKFLOW skill — to build or refresh the zip bundles themselves, use the separate `gptpro` export skill.
